steps.title: Initialize Offline AI Chat Project
steps.description: Set up the package namespace com.offlineaichat.app and project directory architecture for the local AI assistant application.

steps.title: Configure Android manifest metadata
steps.description: Define internet access permissions for model downloads, hardware acceleration, and the application launcher configuration in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle and system targets
steps.description: Define compile, target and min SDK requirements, and verify local Java compatibility with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Design UI layout for Offline AI Chat
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml using native Android SDK UI widgets to establish setup views, model download progress panels, chat interfaces, and settings panels.

steps.title: Implement Device Resource and RAM Detection
steps.description: Add memory monitoring algorithms inside MainActivity to evaluate system RAM capacity and notify the user of low-memory warnings for heavier GGUF models.

steps.title: Build Background HTTP Model Downloader
steps.description: Integrate thread-safe network download processes to securely fetch Qwen 2.5 Instruct GGUF models from remote repositories with real-time speed calculation and progress bars.

steps.title: Develop Offline Simulation & Token Generator
steps.description: Incorporate a simulated local inference engine that mirrors GGUF evaluation timings, active core thread usage, context parameters, and streaming execution layers for offline execution.

steps.title: Incorporate Chat History and Bubble Management
steps.description: Construct custom view adapters in Java to append conversation speech bubbles dynamically, supporting message regeneration, content copying, and dark/light UI shifts.

steps.title: Integrate Chat Settings Control Layer
steps.description: Set up interactive UI input components to adjust runtime thread pools, temperature thresholds, maximum context lengths, and selected offline model files.

steps.title: Verify build configuration & package readiness
steps.description: Audit package identifiers, manifest elements, layout bindings, and resources to prepare the project compilation.

steps.title: Building Offline AI Chat
steps.description: Assemble and build the Offline AI Chat application with compiler diagnostics enabled.
